description: This Java class implements a Liquibase custom task for encrypting tenant passwords in the database during migration. It reads tenant connection records, encrypts their schema passwords using a service, and updates the records accordingly.

classes.name: TenantPasswordEncryptionTask
classes.description: A Liquibase custom task class for encrypting tenant passwords in the database schema, implementing the CustomTaskChange and ApplicationContextAware interfaces.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the password encryption and update procedure over tenant server connections in the database.

methods.description: Returns a confirmation message after execution, currently null.
